define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a single task definition function as a TempateTaskScript
define_task_template_decorator: use define_task_template to create parameterized task templates with a cartesian product of template values
select_max_diverse_subset: call select_max_diverse_subset to filter tasks by diversity based on solution power eval stats and tier
TempateTaskScript_yield_tasks: call yield_tasks on a TempateTaskScript instance to generate tasks from template parameter combinations
TempateTaskScript_call: call a TempateTaskScript with a template_id and optional eval_stats to build and return task instances
